summary: forge sanitise is an operator-invoked maintenance command, not a request hot path. The repo-wide secret scan reads each tracked regular text file once (O(files x size x patterns)); this is inherent to a repo-wide scan, is bounded by tracked source, and skips symlinks and binaries. The factoring adds one extra git ls-files call in check_repo_budget.main() (negligible). No query fanout, I/O amplification, or concurrency bottleneck in any request path; the cadence change removes a daily CI job, a net token and CI reduction.
